company.name: Rekart
company.description:
Rekart is building the UAE's next-generation circular electronics ecosystem by combining refurbishment, trade-in, repair, recycling, and IT asset disposition with technology-driven supply chain management.

Our platform leverages data, automation, and intelligent asset tracking to improve the movement, recovery, grading, refurbishment, and redistribution of electronic devices. By digitizing the electronics lifecycle, we help businesses maximize asset value, reduce operational inefficiencies, and divert devices from landfills.

From enterprise device buyback programs and secure data destruction to certified refurbished sales and responsible recycling, Rekart creates a transparent and efficient circular supply chain that extends the useful life of technology.

Our vision is to become the infrastructure layer powering the circular economy for electronics across the UAE and the wider GCC region.
